name: effective-term-fallback
description: Rules rows apply by the course's term: a Fall 2024 course predating every row still resolves (earliest row applies retroactively), and a two-row course picks the later row from its effective term. CSE 60868 moved dsai→alg in Fall 2027; taken Spring 2028 it lands in alg, so with 60641 (sys) and 60111 (alg) there are only two distinct groups — a wrong row-selection rule would yield three.
